mapper.select:
select config_id, config_key, config_value, config_name, remark, update_time from hys_config
and config_key like concat('%', #{configKey}, '%') and config_name like concat('%', #{configName}, '%')
order by config_id asc
select config_id, config_key, config_value, config_name, remark, update_time from hys_config where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.update: update hys_config set config_value = #{configValue}, update_time = now() where config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_config (config_key, config_value, config_name, remark, update_time) values (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configName}, #{remark}, now())
